title.zh: Rise of crypto vaults channels billions of dollars into risky lending

current_state.zh: Crypto vault products have grown to channel billions of dollars of investor capital into riskier DeFi lending strategies, raising concerns about hidden leverage and contagion risk in on-chain credit markets.
